description.en: HoosierHelp is an interactive benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in social service navigation. Agents interact with simulated users, issue structured resource-search calls, and select final resources from 3,971 Indiana public social service resources. The evaluation focuses on constraint grounding and handling non-ideal user interactions.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing benchmarks do not capture the interaction complexity and constraint-grounding demands of social service navigation. HoosierHelp addresses this gap by simulating realistic user behaviors, providing a basis for assessing agent reliability in a high-stakes domain where incorrect resource recommendations can have serious consequences.
